
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/grey-wolf/p/22681409" title="发布于 2026-08-25 17:10">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">廉颇老矣，装个EclipseMemoryAnalyzer都能卡一小时</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="背景">背景</h1>
<p>大家好，我是逐日。最近运维反馈有个项目的内存有点高，怀疑是不是内存泄漏，我就让他给我dump了一下内存，准备用EclipseMemoryAnalyzer（MAT）分析下。</p>
<p>dump命令： jmap -dump:live,format=b,file=heap.bin 进程pid</p>
<h1 id="mat下载">mat下载</h1>
<p><a href="https://eclipse.dev/mat/download/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://eclipse.dev/mat/download/</a></p>
<p>我是下载的windows版本。</p>
<p>然后解压即可，注意路径不要有中文和空格。</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825163123325.png" alt="image-20260825163123325" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="报错">报错</h1>
<h2 id="jdk21安装">jdk21安装</h2>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825163221235.png" alt="image-20260825163221235" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>由于手里没有多模态模型，只能让豆包协助我了，我其实感觉豆包在多模态这块还不错，平时生活中有个啥搞不懂，拍个图就丢过去了。</p>
<p>豆包先怀疑是不是图里那个jar包不存在，那当然不至于，我甚至发现dbeaver也用了这个jar包：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825163532020.png" alt="image-20260825163532020" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>然后一开始查了下，说新版本的mat要jdk17至少，但我想着再确认下。</p>
<p>用jd-gui.exe反编译了一下,发现有这个Main类：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825163729396.png" alt="image-20260825163729396" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>class字节码的版本是jdk 17，那就至少得jdk17才能打开这个jar包了：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825163800606.png" alt="image-20260825163800606" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>我本地这个新电脑还没jdk17，只有jdk8，那先安装一下。</p>
<p>直接装个jdk21吧：</p>
<p><a href="https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/javase/jdk21-archive-downloads.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/javase/jdk21-archive-downloads.html</a></p>
<p>Windows x64 Installer</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825164015469.png" alt="image-20260825164015469" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="修改mat配置文件使用jdk21">修改MAT配置文件，使用jdk21</h2>
<p>在网上搜了下怎么改配置，以指定jdk21来打开mat。</p>
<p>然后直接就改了下MemoryAnalyzer.ini，网上答案五花八门，我试了好多种错误方案，如：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825164900901.png" alt="image-20260825164900901" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>还有以下错误答案：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">为啥想着加引号，因为路径中间有空格，所以想着加一下：
-vm
"C:/Program Files/Java/jdk-21.0.12/bin/javaw.exe"

-vm
"C:/Program Files/Java/jdk-21.0.12/bin/"

还有windows反斜杠也试了。

</code></pre>
<p>结果后来，在cmd中试成功了：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">这个可以：
F:\tools\MAT\MemoryAnalyzer-1.17.0.20260601-win32.win32.x86_64&gt;MemoryAnalyzer.exe -vm "C:/Program Files/Java/jdk-21.0.12/bin/"
</code></pre>
<p>但我把同样配置弄到配置文件里，还是不行；然后豆包给我说，ini文件里不能用引号，那就这样：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825165337303.png" alt="image-20260825165337303" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>结果还是报错。</p>
<p>豆包又一顿分析，说要不你就是文件的格式是utf8（带了bom），导致这一行格式有问题：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825165459000.png" alt="image-20260825165459000" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="vscode安装hex-editor插件直接查看二进制">vscode安装Hex Editor插件直接查看二进制</h2>
<p>正常来说，在notepad++之类或者vscode里，看到是utf8，可能基本能确定是UTF8还是带bom的utf8.</p>
<p>为了看得清清楚楚，我们可以直接看二进制。</p>
<p>vscode中有个hex editor插件：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825165808873.png" alt="image-20260825165808873" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>文件上右键，</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825165832883.png" alt="image-20260825165832883" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>通过前几个字节就能看出来有没有bom：</p>
<ul>
<li>如果输出开头是 <code>EF BB BF</code> → 存在 UTF‑8 BOM</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825165926456.png" alt="image-20260825165926456" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>按理说，我上面那个没bom，结果还是有问题。</p>
<p>豆包又给我分析了下，这次可是真分析到点上了，原来是短横线有点问题：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825170317624.png" alt="image-20260825170317624" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>然后手动重新敲了下短横线。还真的可以了。卧槽...</p>
<h2 id="内存调整">内存调整</h2>
<p>mat需要自己调整下内存，不然dump文件很大就打不开：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825170740982.png" alt="image-20260825170740982" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="总结">总结</h1>
<p>刚写文的时候，找到了mat对应的github，发现readme里面就写了要怎么设置vm，结果当时没看到这个页面。折腾半天。</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/eclipse-mat/mat/wiki/faq" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/eclipse-mat/mat/wiki/faq</a></p>
<p>贴一下我这的配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">-vm
C:/Program Files/Java/jdk-21.0.12/bin/
-startup
plugins/org.eclipse.equinox.launcher_1.7.100.v20251111-0406.jar
--launcher.library
plugins/org.eclipse.equinox.launcher.win32.win32.x86_64_1.3.0.v20260203-2149
-vmargs
--add-exports=java.base/jdk.internal.org.objectweb.asm=ALL-UNNAMED
-Xmx2048m
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260825170819538.png" alt="image-20260825170819538" loading="lazy"></p>
